extraction.Name: Sarah Douville, formerly Sarah Cournoyer
extraction.Recorded patent: The patent was recorded January 21, 1921 but the records do not show who submitted it for record
extraction.Buyer: Sarah Douville and her husband conveyed the land to John Cournoyer for $1.00 and other valuable consideration
extraction.NOTES: Fee patent No. 739673 issued; southeast quarter of section 9, township 96, range 72; receipt for patent signed by allottee April 3, 1920; deed dated May 24, 1920
